title: Finite etale descent to a finitely presented algebra stage
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $B$ any commutative A-algebra, $f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $U\to Y_B=Y\times_A\operatorname{Spec}B$ finite etale [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. There exist a finitely presented A-algebra R, an A-algebra map $c:R\to B$, a finite etale cover $W\to Y_R=Y\times_A\operatorname{Spec}R$, and $l:Y_B\to Y_R$ whose Y projection is canonical and whose R projection is the B projection followed by Spec(c), with an isomorphism $W\times_{Y_R,l}Y_B\cong U$ over $Y_B$.

proof.text: $B$ as a limit of finite type $A$-algebras. For a finite subset $F\subseteq B$ let $A_F\subseteq B$ be the $A$-subalgebra generated by $F$; the $F$ are directed by inclusion, $A_F\subseteq A_{F'}$ for $F\subseteq F'$, and every element of $B$ lies in some $A_F$, so $B=\varinjlim_FA_F$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] with the inclusions $\iota_F:A_F\to B$. Each $A_F$ is of finite type over the Noetherian ring $A$, hence of finite presentation (Hilbert basis theorem; Mathlib Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType). Hence $\operatorname{Spec}B=\varprojlim_F\operatorname{Spec}A_F$ with affine transition morphisms [lem-weil-pbc-spec-colimit-limit]. Put $Y_F=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}A_F=Y_\emptyset\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A_\emptyset}\operatorname{Spec}A_F$; then $Y_B=\varprojlim_FY_F$ with affine transition morphisms [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-over-limit] (applied to $T=Y_\emptyset\to\operatorname{Spec}A_\emptyset$). Each $Y_F\to\operatorname{Spec}A_F$ is proper [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change], hence quasi-compact and separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], so $Y_F$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\operatorname{Spec}A_F$ being affine.

proof.text: Descent of the cover to a finite stage. $U\to Y_B$ is finite, hence affine, quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and etale, hence locally of finite presentation [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]; so it is of finite presentation. By [thm-pd-spreading-out] (1), applied to the system $(Y_F)$ of step 3, there are $F_0$ and a morphism of finite presentation $W_{F_0}\to Y_{F_0}$ with $W_{F_0}\times_{Y_{F_0}}Y_B\cong U$ over $Y_B$; $W_{F_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, being of finite presentation over the qcqs $Y_{F_0}$. For $F\supseteq F_0$ let $W_F=W_{F_0}\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A_{F_0}}\operatorname{Spec}A_F$, so $W_F\to Y_F$ is the base change of $W_{F_0}\to Y_{F_0}$ to the stage $\operatorname{Spec}A_F$ of the system $(\operatorname{Spec}A_F)_{F\supseteq F_0}$ (limit $\operatorname{Spec}B$) and its base change to the limit is $U\to Y_B$, which is finite and etale. By [lem-weil-pbc-descend-finite] (with $W_{F_0}\to Y_{F_0}$ locally of finite type) and [lem-weil-pbc-descend-etale] (with it locally of finite presentation) there are $F_1,F_2\supseteq F_0$ with $W_{F_1}\to Y_{F_1}$ finite and $W_{F_2}\to Y_{F_2}$ etale; for $F=F_1\cup F_2$, $W_F\to Y_F$ is a base change of both, hence finite and etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], and $W_F\times_{Y_F}Y_B\cong U$.

proof.text: Set R to the common finite stage and c to its inclusion into B. The base-change morphism l is defined by the projection to Y and Spec(c) composed with the projection to Spec(B); the algebra-map condition makes these compatible. Pasting the base-change squares transports the spread-out isomorphism to an isomorphism of covers over Y_B, with exactly these projections.
